email_subject: Application - Digital Marketing Expert Retention at Atlas Copco Specialty Rental
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Expert Retention role at Atlas Copco Specialty Rental. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and content, I am eager to contribute to your digital transformation journey.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. I also maintain CRM records for a cleaning-services client, ensuring accurate follow-up. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This blend of technical and creative skills aligns well with your focus on data-driven customer experiences.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work with marketing automation platforms like Pardot/MCAE, develop customer journeys, and collaborate with global teams. I am a quick learner, comfortable with analytics tools such as Google Analytics and SEMrush, and fluent in English. I am excited about the chance to grow within your organization and support retention and expansion of customer accounts.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Expert Retention position at Atlas Copco Specialty Rental. Your focus on data-driven customer experiences and marketing automation resonates with my background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation. I am eager to contribute to your digital transformation journey and help strengthen customer engagement and retention.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress websites for client sites. I also maintain CRM records for a cleaning-services client, ensuring accurate follow-up and supporting marketing efforts. This experience has given me a solid foundation in lead generation, email marketing, and customer journey basics. Additionally, on my personal project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on work has honed my analytical skills and ability to translate technical solutions into clear customer value.

I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work with marketing automation platforms such as Pardot/MCAE, develop automated customer journeys, and collaborate with regional marketing and sales teams. While I am still growing into marketing automation, I am a quick learner and have experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. I am confident in my ability to pick up new platforms and processes, and I thrive in collaborative, cross-cultural environments.

I am fluent in English and native in Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am continuously improving my Dutch. I am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp, and open to hybrid work in Boom. I am enthusiastic about the chance to bring my creativity, analytical mindset, and customer-focused approach to Atlas Copco Specialty Rental.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
